sourceText:
Idli Rice cake
By: nil kamath
Published: Thursday, March 22, 2012 - 2:13am

Ingredients




Many people use Idli rava (rice sooji) for making idlis. But in this
method rice is used directly.
Ingredients
Urad dal – 3/4th cup
Rice – 2 cups
Poha/puffed rice – 1/4th cup
A pinch of salt
Baking soda

Preparation

1 Soak rice and daal in separate containers for 4-5 hours (preferably previous afternoon) 2 Just 15 minutes before grinding, soak poha. 3 Grind the urad daal to a very smooth batter (Do not add too much water, just add as much as needed).Set this aside. 4 Now grind the rice and poha. Again dont add more water. Grind this till you get a very fine rava-like consistency of the rice in the batter. 5 Now mix the 2 batters, add some salt and keep the batter overnight in a warm place.(Take care to use a big container here as the volume of the batter increases after fermentation) 6 In the morning add a little baking soda 15 mins before cooking. 7 Grease the idli-stand with a little oil and steam the idlis for about 15 minutes. Open the idli cooker after 5-10 mins and the idlis are ready !!! 8 Preparation time: 30 minutes + Leave overnight 9 Cooking time: 20 minutes

About

This sunday  I made an elaborate-Sunday-breakfast :) comprising
of idli, and ofcourse tea.Earlier, they are very soft, fluffy and yummy.
So I thought of sharing this recipe with other idli-newbies
